args.body:
Migration is complete: all 10 batches, 400 records, are in the new CRM.

Problem you should act on before the team relies on phone numbers: the old CRM stored numbers without country codes, and the new CRM saved every number with a +1 prefix. Of the first 120 records (batches 1–3), 31 belong to overseas customers, so those numbers are wrong. The validator said batches 4–10 have the same problem; I do not have a count of affected records in those batches, and I did not change any phone numbers because I do not have the correct country codes.

Also, 14 sales users opened customer records in the new CRM in the last 24 hours, so some of them may already be using incorrect numbers.

I can update individual numbers with the update tool once you have the correct values, or hold for a bulk correction if you prefer that. Recommend treating overseas phone numbers as unreliable until then.
